properties.Name: Downside Bus Stop (X4)
properties.description: Nearest stop for the X4 bus between Portishead and Bristol city centre (approx. every 10 mins, ~45 min journey).

properties.Name: The Royal Inn
properties.description: Waterfront pub on Pier Road (BS20 7HG), next to Eastwood Local Nature Reserve.

properties.Name: The Windmill
properties.description: Pub at 58 Nore Road (BS20 6JZ) overlooking Kilkenny Bay, near Fisherman's Steps.

properties.Name: Mokoko Coffee & Bakery
properties.description: Coffee & bakery on Portishead Marina (311–313 Newfoundland Way, BS20 7QH).

properties.Name: SeaRock Fish & Chips
properties.description: Seafood restaurant and fish & chip takeaway on Portishead Marina (Sixty8 at the Marina, 313A Newfoundland Way, BS20 7QH), next to Mokoko.

properties.Name: Portishead Quays Marina
properties.description: Scenic marina with waterside boardwalks, lock bridge, cafes, and views across the estuary.

properties.Name: Portishead Marina Lock
properties.description: Tidal lock connecting Portishead Quays Marina to the Severn Estuary, with a pedestrian footbridge across the lock gates.

properties.Name: Battery Point Lighthouse
properties.description: Historic coastal lighthouse at Battery Point (Portishead Point) overlooking the Bristol Channel, between the Lake Grounds and Eastwood Reserve.

properties.Name: Victorian Lake Grounds
properties.description: Boating lake, parkland, and seafront promenade linking towards Battery Point and Eastwood Reserve.

properties.Name: Eastwood Local Nature Reserve
properties.description: Woodland and coastal trails linking the Victorian Lake Grounds and Battery Point to Portishead Marina.

properties.Name: Fisherman's Steps (Kilkenny Bay)
properties.description: Steps down to the water's edge at Kilkenny Bay along Mariners Path, near The Windmill.

properties.Name: Portbury Wharf Nature Reserve
properties.description: Coastal wetland nature reserve with bird hides (Tower Hide, North Pool Hide, and South Pool Hide).
